summary: The audit checks POLISCI 114D (or INTNLREL 114D) for 5 units and a letter grade, outside the program's 9 units, and DDRL 189 and DDRL 190 taken twice, each for 3 units. DDRL 191 independent study is optional. You check by hand the two related preparatory courses the faculty director approves, the 3.5 GPA, the honors college in Washington, D.C., and the honors thesis and its defense.

node.name: Honors college in Washington, D.C. (September before senior autumn)

add.why: Program Overview: "Students are required to attend honors college in Washington, D.C., in September before autumn quarter classes begin."

node.name: Honors thesis submitted and defended (mid-May of senior year)

add.why: Program Overview: "They will spend the last quarter of the senior year working independently with their faculty advisor to complete and submit their honors thesis ahead of their formal defense in mid-May. Upon fulfilling individual department course requirements and completing the honors program, students graduate with a certificate in Honors in Democracy, Development, and the Rule of Law."
